DeletedHistoryCorrupt: Saved deleted-name history was damaged. A fresh Dropbox listing is being acquired; saved names never authorize deletion.
StateSchemaUpgradeRequired: Please upgrade with a compatible writable host before opening this database read-only.
ResolutionIgnoreConsequence: Hide this notice. This does not resolve the problem, release a safety hold, or stop syncing the file. Later changes are handled normally. Restore the notice from Ignored while the problem remains.
ResolutionRestoreConsequence: Restore this notice to the active list. This does not start a sync or resolve the problem.
ResolutionIgnoreHeldConsequence: This item remains held until the problem is resolved.
ResolutionIgnorePairConsequence: This pair stays stopped until the problem is resolved. Restore the notice from Ignored to act on it.
ResultIssueIgnored: Notice {Id} is hidden in Ignored. Its problem, holds and retry work are unchanged.
ResultIssueRestored: Notice {Id} is restored to the active list. This does not resolve its problem or start a sync.
SkipOnlineOnly: Not synced: {Path} is online-only on this PC.
SkipLink: Not synced: {Path} is a link or shortcut to another location.
SkipSpecial: Not synced: {Path} is a special Windows item that cannot be copied.
SkipNotDownloadable: Not synced: Dropbox does not allow {Path} to be downloaded.
SkipReservedName: Not synced: Windows cannot use the name {Path}. Rename it in Dropbox to sync it.
RetryChanged: Retrying {Path}: its observed state changed; checking the current version.
FailChanged: Could not sync {Path}: its observed state changed or could not be confirmed as current. Sync will retry at the next sync opportunity.
FailReplacementRetained: The replacement of {Path} stopped because some content must be kept. The notice stays open.
FailEarlierReplace: Could not replace {Path}: an earlier replace is still unfinished; the next Repair finishes it first.
FailCarriesOtherPair: Did not move {Path}: it contains another pair's folder.
FailExcludeHoldsProtected: Did not remove {Path}: it contains online-only, separately excluded or another pair's items, which are never touched.
PublishFailed: Could not put the new version of {Path} in place. {Message}
RecycleUnavailable: Did not delete {Path}: the Recycle Bin is not available for it.
RecycleFailed: Could not move {Path} to the Recycle Bin. {Message}
ReadLocalFailed: Could not read {Path} on this PC. {Message}
LocalNameInvalid: Could not use {Path} on this PC: Windows does not allow that name. {Message}
ClashFileFolder: {Path} is a file on one side and a folder on the other.
ClashMappedDiffers: {Path} has a Dropbox name Windows cannot use, and the two versions differ.
ClashMappedNames: More than one Dropbox item maps to the Windows name {Path}.
ClashNameTaken: {Path} is already taken by a different item.
TieEqualTimes: {Path} differs on the two sides but both were changed in the same second.
TieUnreliableTime: {Path} differs on the two sides and one side's modified time cannot be trusted.
TieCaseBoth: The capitalisation of {Path} was changed differently on the two sides.
TieKindBoth: {Path} was changed on both sides, and one side changed between file and folder.
InfoNewestWins: {Path}: the newer version replaced a different older one.
InfoEditBeatsDelete: {Path} was deleted on one side but edited on the other; the edited version was kept and restored.
InfoKeptBoth: {Path}: both versions were kept. Linked originals and labelled copies are synced files, not independent backups. Deleting either endpoint of a linked version also deletes its unchanged counterpart on the other side; an edited counterpart is kept and copied back to where it was deleted. To retain a version before cleaning up, copy it outside all synced folders and verify that copy before deleting. Dismiss only hides this notice; it does not delete files or stop syncing.
InfoKeptBothRetained: {Path}: both versions were kept on this side. Dismiss only hides this notice.
InfoKeptBothLocations: Locations recorded when the versions were kept (paths relative to this pair’s roots):
InfoKeptBothLocalVersion: Version from this PC: this PC "{Path}"; Dropbox "{Name}".
InfoKeptBothDropboxVersion: Version from Dropbox: Dropbox "{Path}"; this PC "{Name}".
InfoKeptBothLocalOnly: Version from this PC: this PC "{Path}". Version from Dropbox: this PC "{Name}".
InfoKeptBothDropboxOnly: Version from Dropbox: Dropbox "{Path}". Version from this PC: Dropbox "{Name}".
InfoMovedTwice: {Path} was moved to different places on the two sides; it now exists in both places.
InfoMovedEdited: {Path} was moved on one side and edited on the other; both versions were kept.
InfoMovedDeleted: {Path} was moved on one side and deleted on the other; the moved item was kept.
InfoFolderSpelling: The folder {Path} was spelled differently on the two sides; both now use one spelling.
PairUnknown: There is no pair with id {Pair}.
PairDisabled: Pair {Pair} is switched off. Switch it on before repairing it.
LocalRootMissing: The local folder {Path} does not exist.
DropboxPathInvalid: The Dropbox folder must start with / (for example /Projects); got {Path}.
AccountMissing: The Dropbox account {Account} is not connected.
ResolveStale: Notice {Id} no longer matches the items on disk; run Repair to refresh it.
ResolveBadChoice: {Choice} is not a choice for notice {Id}.
ImportUnsupported: Pair {Pair} cannot be imported: its local/Dropbox configuration, saved baseline or root identities do not match the supported import contract.
ImportMissing: There is no existing Sync Shark pair with id {Pair}.
ImportReadFailed: Pair {Pair} could not be imported because its database or current roots could not be read, or its baseline could not be stored.
SettingsDefaultsInvalid: The built-in setting {Name} is missing or not valid.
SettingsFileInvalid: The settings file is not valid: {Message}
NetworkDown: Waiting for the network to come back.
WaitTooManyRequests: Dropbox asked Sync Shark to slow down; waiting {Seconds} seconds.
WaitTooManyWrites: Dropbox is busy with other changes in this account; waiting {Seconds} seconds.
StagePending: Finishing the previous run's interrupted replace
StageProgress: {Name}: progress; count {Count} of {SourceCount}; current {Path}; elapsed {Seconds} seconds.
RequestWaiting: Provider {Name}: waiting; current {Path}; started {Value}; elapsed {Seconds} seconds.
RequestEnded: Provider {Name}: ended; current {Path}; status {Reason}; started {Value}; elapsed {Seconds} seconds.
RequestEndedCause: Provider {Name}: ended; current {Path}; status {Reason}; cause {Cause}; started {Value}; elapsed {Seconds} seconds.
StageInterrupted: {Name}: interrupted after {Seconds} seconds; final count unavailable.
StageDropboxPages: Receiving Dropbox pages (ends at last provider page)
StagePairLookup: Validating pair in read-only state store
StageStore: Opening state store (including SQLite lock waits)
StageConfiguration: Waiting for host configuration and composing pair
StageSourceBase: Preparing Dropbox source base (including provider waits)
ListingEstimate: {Count} entry observations (not unique paths); {Value} of historical baseline ~{SourceCount}
ResultPairImported: Source {SourceCount} baseline rows; imported {Count}; discarded {Value} stale folder rows.
ResultPairRemoved: Pair {Pair} was removed; no files were touched.
ResultExcludePreview: Excluding {Path} will first sync {CopyFiles} new or changed items ({CopyBytes} bytes) to the other side, then remove {RemoveFiles} items ({RemoveBytes} bytes) from {Side}. They can be recovered from {Place}. Repeat with --yes to apply.
ResultExcludeApplied: {Path} is excluded; the next Repair applies it.
ResultExcludeBlocked: Excluding {Path} will not remove anything: it holds online-only, separately excluded or another pair's items, which are never touched.
ResultRepairIncomplete: Repair stopped before syncing: {Reason}. Only an interrupted replace left by the previous run may have been finished.
ResultRepairLogFailed: The run log could not be written; the changes above were still made.
ResultHistoryNoCursor: The Engine host keeps one Repair summary per pair and has no run-history cursor; the latest retained summary is shown.
StateSchemaTooOld: This engine database requires a supported preserving upgrade before it can be opened: {Path}. Keep the database and recovery data; do not delete them or reset the pair.
SkipUnreadable: Not synced: {Path} could not be read on this PC. The next Repair will try again.
FailDropboxNameRejected: Dropbox does not allow the name {Path}. Rename the item before retrying.
FailDropboxNoPermission: Dropbox does not allow changes to {Path}. Check your access, then retry.
FailDropboxNoSpace: Dropbox has insufficient space for {Path}. Free space; the next Repair will try again.
FailLocalNoSpace: This drive has insufficient available space for {Path}, after allowing for downloads already in progress. Free space or let those downloads finish; the next Repair will try again.
PairAwaitingDecision: Pair {Pair} is paused by a drive-change notice. Choose how to continue before running Repair.
DriveRestored: This drive's change journal went backwards without changing identity, so the drive appears to have been restored from a backup image. This pair is paused until you choose. Saved sync records may be newer than these files: syncing normally could delete the Dropbox copies of files missing here and replace newer Dropbox versions with the older restored ones.
DriveChanged: This pair is now on a different or reformatted drive. This pair is paused until you choose. Saved sync records may be newer than these files: syncing normally could delete the Dropbox copies of files missing here and replace newer Dropbox versions with the older copies on this drive.
ResolveSameSideUnsupported: Replacing an existing item on the same side is not supported. Choose a different name for the incoming item.
ResolveSubjectStale: This notice no longer matches the items on disk; run Repair to refresh it.
StateLocalKeyInvalid: The saved local path key is not valid: {Path}.
StateSchemaTooNew: This engine database was made by a newer version of Sync Shark. Open it with that version or a newer one: {Path}
StageCleanupFailed: Could not remove the unused stage file {Path}. The next Repair will try again. {Message}
ResultFailureRetry: To retry a failure, use engine resolve --pair {Pair} --issue <number> --choice retry --yes; to retry every failure in this pair, use --all instead of --issue <number>.
ResultDriveChoices: Leave this notice open to stop. Use engine resolve --pair {Pair} --issue {Id} --choice first-sync --yes to reset this pair's sync history and first-run state with its saved first-sync rule, or add --first-run newest-wins, local-wins or dropbox-wins to choose the rule. This administrative reset checks the configured root identities but does not sync files; surviving or newly arrived children do not prevent it. Protected recovery data is retained. Subsequent normal synchronization can replace an existing version with the chosen winner. Use --choice sync-normally to keep the saved sync records and sync normally, including deletions and replacement by older local copies, without a separate final verification pass. To request removal of the pair without touching files, use engine pairs remove --pair {Pair} --yes; unresolved recovery responsibility can prevent removal.
ResultDriveChoiceRecorded: Choice {Choice} recorded for notice {Id}. This result records the administrative choice, not a completed sync. Normal synchronization is separate.
ResultIgnoreRulesDefaults: Only pair-specific rules are listed. Engine defaults also apply; use engine settings list to view DefaultIgnoreRules.
ExclusionPathInvalid: The exclusion path {Path} is not valid. {Message}
ResultFolderKeepRulesExplanation: When these preferences cover all retained ignored contents, the folder is kept without repeating the keep notice. They do not change ignore scope. No global keep defaults apply.
ResultRootsBound: Root identities saved for pair {Pair}. Existing sync history is unchanged.
DownloadHashMismatch: The download of {Path} failed content-hash verification. Nothing was published.
FailLocalSpaceUnknown: Could not safely check destination space for {Path}. The next Repair will try again.
FailDownloadSizeInvalid: Could not download {Path}: the source size is invalid. The next Repair will read the source again.
FailLocalInUse: {Path} is in use, so Sync Shark couldn't sync it.
FailLocalInUseOrAccessDenied: Windows refused access to {Path}, so Sync Shark couldn't sync it. It may be open in another app, or access may be denied. Close the app if it is using this item, or check access permissions.
RetryRunning: Sync Shark is trying again now.
RetryWaiting: It will be retried when it changes, at the next Repair, or when you choose Retry.
RetryOffline: Retry needs a connection. When connected, it can retry when the file changes, at the next Repair, or when you choose Retry.
RetryPaused: Retry is paused. Resume AutoSync for change-triggered retry, or run Repair or choose Retry when available.
RetryRepairOnly: It will be retried at the next Repair or when you choose Retry; change-triggered retry requires AutoSync.
RetryRecoveryRequired: Recovery needs your attention; review the recovery notice.
RetryUnavailable: Automatic retry status is unavailable. Check status or run Repair.
RequiredRepairRetry: This pair is not up to date. A prerequisite failed; automatic retries continue.
StatusWatching: Watching for changes; no runnable work.
StatusPaused: Paused for this host session; watching for changes continues. The pause ends when the host restarts.
StatusDisabled: Switched off; not watching or syncing.
JournalSourceFailed: Local change tracking stopped ({Reason}; native error {Value}). Normal Repair is required to resume from saved state.
JournalRepairRequired: Local change tracking is unavailable; normal Repair is required.
InfoIgnoredFolderKept: This folder was deleted in Dropbox, but it still contains ignored files. The files and folder were kept.
InfoDropboxHistoryUnchecked: Dropbox history could not be checked. This item was treated as new and synced normally.
InfoPairPausedInOldApp: Pair {Pair} was paused in the old app and was imported switched off. It will remain off after restart until you explicitly enable it. New AutoSync pauses last only for the host session and end when the host restarts.
DeletionTimeMissing: Dropbox history for {Path} did not include a deletion time.
DeletionTimeMalformed: Dropbox history for {Path} contained an invalid deletion time.
DeletionTimeUnavailable: The deletion time for {Path} could not be obtained from Dropbox history.
DeletionHashMissing: Dropbox history for {Path} did not include a content hash.
DeletionHashMalformed: Dropbox history for {Path} contained an invalid content hash.
DeletionHashUnavailable: The content hash for {Path} could not be obtained from Dropbox history.
RootUnbound: This pair has no saved root identities. Review its configured locations, then explicitly bind this pair before syncing.
RootChanged: A configured root no longer matches its saved identity. Restore or reconnect the original folder and account, then check again. To intentionally use different folders, create a new pair and use first sync. Binding cannot approve replacement identities.
RootUnavailable: A configured root could not be verified. Restore access and retry. Unsupported storage remains unsupported in this build; a later Repair cannot enable support.
RootScopeChanged: The configured locations or connection no longer match the saved root scope. Restore or reconnect the original folder and account, then check again. To intentionally use different folders, create a new pair and use first sync. Binding cannot approve replacement identities.
StateRootBindingInvalid: The saved root binding is invalid. Syncing is refused. Preserve the existing state and recovery data; do not reset or delete it to bypass this error.
FailDropboxDeleteJobInvalid: Dropbox cannot check this deletion job. The operation remains blocked; Sync Shark will check again on the next Repair or AutoSync opportunity.
FailFirstSyncCheckWaiting: The first-sync check for {Path} cannot finish until another notice or item is resolved. The next Repair will check it again.
RootLocalNetworkUnsupported: The local root is on a network share, which this build does not support for stable root identity. Use a supported local location. Retrying or running Repair cannot enable this support.
RootLocalFormatUnsupported: The local root is on removable storage whose format this build does not support for stable root identity. Use supported storage. Retrying or running Repair cannot enable this support.
RootLocalAccessDenied: Access to the configured local root was denied, so its identity could not be verified. Restore the required access and retry. No replacement root has been approved.
RootLocalIdentityUnavailable: The configured local root's stable identity could not be read. Check that the original location is available and accessible, then retry. No replacement root has been approved.
RootLocalIdentityChanged: The configured local root is not the saved local directory, or it was replaced during the check. Restore or reconnect the original folder and account, then check again. To intentionally use different folders, create a new pair and use first sync. Binding cannot approve replacement identities.
RootDropboxAccessUnavailable: Dropbox refused access to the configured root or could not provide its metadata. Restore access to the correct account and configured folder, then retry. No replacement root has been approved.
RootDropboxTransportUnavailable: The connection to Dropbox failed or timed out while checking the configured root. Restore connectivity and retry. No root change has been accepted.
RootDropboxIdentityInvalid: Dropbox returned incomplete or invalid root identity information. Syncing is refused because this response cannot establish the configured root's identity. Retry when valid metadata is available.
RootDropboxFolderChanged: The configured Dropbox root is not the saved folder, is not a folder, or was replaced during the check. Restore or reconnect the original folder and account, then check again. To intentionally use different folders, create a new pair and use first sync. Binding cannot approve replacement identities.
RootDropboxScopeChanged: The Dropbox account or namespace no longer matches the saved binding. Restore or reconnect the original folder and account, then check again. To intentionally use different folders, create a new pair and use first sync. Binding cannot approve replacement identities.
RootConfiguredScopeChanged: The configured local path, Dropbox path or connection no longer matches the root binding. Restore or reconnect the original folder and account, then check again. To intentionally use different folders, create a new pair and use first sync. Binding cannot approve replacement identities.
MoveDataUnavailableInEngine: Data cannot be moved from this Engine window.
ResolutionUseLocalConsequence: Use the local item for this notice. The corresponding Dropbox item may be renamed or replaced, including removal of a conflicting file or folder. The selected identities will be checked again before changes.
ResolutionUseDropboxConsequence: Use the Dropbox item for this notice. The corresponding local item may be renamed or replaced, including removal of a conflicting file or folder. The selected identities will be checked again before changes.
ResolutionKeepBothConsequence: Keep both versions using separate names. This may create or rename files on both sides; the selected identities will be checked again before changes.
ResolutionDismissConsequence: Close this notice without changing its files. This does not record a successful synchronization.
ResolutionRenameConsequence: Rename the selected item to the name you entered, then reconcile the new and freed locations. An occupied destination will not be overwritten by the rename.
ResolutionReplaceConsequence: Use the selected incoming item and replace the conflicting existing item. This may remove a conflicting file or folder; the selected identities will be checked again before changes.
ResolutionRetryConsequence: Retry this notice against current observations. Normal synchronization rules may copy, replace or remove items; an uncertain earlier effect will not be blindly replayed.
ResolutionFirstSyncConsequence: Reset the saved synchronization decision and use the chosen first-sync policy for fresh planning. This may lead to file replacements when synchronization runs.
ResolutionSyncNormallyConsequence: Acknowledge this drive-change notice and retain normal synchronization planning. Existing synchronization rules may copy, replace or remove items.
ResolutionBindRootsLabel: Check and bind the configured roots
ResolutionBindRootsConsequence: Check both configured root folders. An unbound pair will be bound; an existing binding is accepted only if both identities still match. This does not reset sync history or change files.
ResolutionKeepFolderConsequence: Save the reviewed keep-folder rules for this pair and acknowledge this notice. This does not delete the folder.
RecoveryCheckConsequence: Check this exact operation using its recorded evidence and current observations. An uncertain outcome will not be treated as permission to repeat the original deletion or overwrite a current item.
RecoveryFolderCheckConsequence: Check this folder operation's job, change-feed and member evidence without repeating its deletion or replaying an uncertain publication.
RecoveryLegacyCheckConsequence: Check the recorded locations and report what is known. This legacy recovery note will not be changed, and no file will be published or deleted.
RecoveryAcceptCurrentConsequence: Acknowledge the current recovery state for fresh planning. This does not record the original operation as successful, overwrite a current item, or retry the original deletion. Only this recovery issue can be closed.
RecoveryAcceptFolderItemConsequence: Acknowledge this item's current or uncertain recovery state and preserve any current occupant. This does not record a successful historical publication, delete remote files, or authorize another folder deletion.
RecoveryAcceptFolderOperationConsequence: Acknowledge this folder operation's unresolved outcome and unfinished work. This does not mark the deletion complete or claim that unfinished work ran. Active ownership can be released only after recovery custody and job handling are settled.
RecoveryAbandonIncomingConsequence: Abandon this recovery attempt. Only a verified, owned incoming stage may be discarded. This does not delete current remote files or retry the original deletion; only this recovery issue can be closed.
RecoveryAbandonIncomingPending: Abandonment of this incoming recovery was requested. Only its verified owned stage may be discarded; the selected bytes must not be published.
RecoveryLegacyStageBlocked: The legacy stage location {Place} must be handled outside Sync Shark. Acknowledgement is blocked while that location is present, substituted or unreadable. Sync Shark will not adopt or delete its contents.
RecoveryStageLocationBlocked: Recovery cannot prove ownership at {Place}. Preserve or handle any contents there manually. This operation cannot be cleared while the location is present or unreadable, and Sync Shark will not delete or adopt an unknown object.
RecoveryRetained: Recovery for {Path} is retained and needs attention. The requested removal or publication has not been confirmed as successful. Inspect this operation before choosing an available recovery action.
RecoveryUnknown: The outcome at {Path} is unknown. Do not treat a missing path as proof of success or permission to repeat the operation. Inspect this exact recovery operation before taking further action.
RecoveryUnknownOperation: The outcome of recovery operation {Id} is unknown. No successful removal or publication is being claimed, and an uncertain effect must not be repeated blindly.
RecoveryIncomplete: The folder operation at {Path} is not complete. A failed member, recovered survivor, incomplete check or unresolved recovery remains. Completed effects remain real; this result does not authorize another deletion or replacement.
RecoveryKnownPathManual: Recovery at the known path {Path} needs manual attention. Inspect the recorded version and available history. Sync Shark will not overwrite a current occupant or guess which version to restore.
RecoveryDiscoveryIncomplete: Recovery discovery is incomplete. The app cannot promise a specific notice for an item it never discovers. You may need to inspect Dropbox history yourself.
RecoveryHistoryLimits: Expiry, permanent deletion, permissions or team policy can prevent recovery; we have not verified your account's exact period.
RecoveryPublishedBytesLimits: The selected bytes were verified at the fixed path. The original file identity, history, shared links, properties, permissions and comments are not promised to be restored.
RecoveryWrongRestored: The wrong item was restored at {Path}. This is not success of the requested removal, and the incoming replacement has not been authorized by this result.
RecoveryKnownVictimInBin: The known recycled item remains in the Recycle Bin at {Place}. Preserve it and review this exact recovery operation before taking further action.
RecoveryVictimUnknown: The affected item's identity or location is unknown. No recovery or preservation of that item is being claimed.
RecoveryAcknowledged: The recovery decision for operation {Id} was recorded. This does not claim the original operation succeeded or authorize its replay.
RecoveryNoEffect: No effect was confirmed for this attempt. This is not confirmation that the requested operation completed.
RecoveryRemoved: The selected removal was verified. Any remaining recovery, publication or settlement work keeps its own status.
RecoveryPublished: Publication at {Path} was verified. This result does not imply that unrelated recovery work is complete.
EngineStartupFailed: Engine connection/start could not complete. Nothing was opened locally.
EnginePreferencesFailed: Saved appearance/display preferences could not be loaded. Existing saved data was not reset.
EngineReleaseRecoveryFailed: The interrupted installation or rollback must finish before Sync Shark can use its saved state.
EngineLocationFailed: Sync Shark cannot open its configured data folder.
EngineBusyFailed: Another Sync Shark window, legacy background host, or maintenance operation owns the data. Close that window safely or let maintenance finish. For a verified legacy background host, run SyncShark.exe --cli --core v2 autosync stop --yes, then reopen Sync Shark.
EngineLegacyOwnerGuidance: The Engine host is running in the background. Open Sync Shark without arguments to reconnect. To use this legacy operation, first run SyncShark.exe --cli engine host stop --yes, wait for it to finish, then try again.
UnsavedSettingsDetail: Save the edited Settings categories, discard their drafts, or stay here.
EngineUpdatePreferenceOnly: This Engine window saves update preferences only. It does not check for, download, verify or install updates. The saved automatic-check preference applies to the legacy window.
HumanAttentionUnsyncedResult: This item remains unsynced; other work continues.
HumanAttentionFailedResult: Failure recorded; the completion record states whether processing finished.
HumanAttentionStoppedResult: Stopped before finishing; retained work is reconciled by the next run.
HumanWaitActivity: Activity:   Other independent work can continue.
HumanStageOverlap: Stage times overlap; do not add parent and child durations.
HumanMalformedRecord: Skipped a malformed record at line {Value}.
HumanSizesNotRecorded: File sizes are not recorded in run logs; cards omit size.
HumanLogNotFound: There is no stored log for pair {Pair} and run {Run}.
HumanLogInvalid: The pair or run id is not valid; use the exact ids from the log file name.
HumanLogUnreadable: The stored log could not be read; its retained evidence was not changed.
StaleDescendantEvidence: {Path} was acquired after {Count}; the folder deletion is clean {Value}; the descendant is clean {Name}.
